attractions.name: Spectra – Light & Water Show
attractions.description: A free nightly performance of dancing fountains, colorful projections, and music set against the bay skyline
attractions.hours: Daily at 8:00 PM and 9:00 PM, with an additional 10:00 PM show on Fridays and Saturdays

attractions.name: Singapore Cable Car
attractions.description: Panoramic aerial views of Sentosa, Mount Faber, the harbour, and Singapore's skyline during a scenic cable car ride.
attractions.hours: First ride: 8:45 AM | Last boarding: 9:30 PM

attractions.name: Skyline Luge Sentosa
attractions.description: One of Sentosa's most popular attractions combining scenic chairlift rides with downhill luge tracks overlooking the island.

attractions.name: Harry Potter: Visions of Magic
attractions.description: An immersive, multi-sensory journey filled with spellbinding sets, interactive technology, and atmospheric soundscapes that transport you straight into the wizarding world

attractions.name: Universal Studios Singapore
attractions.description: Movie-themed park combining immersive experiences, live entertainment, and thrilling rides across themed zones including Hollywood, Sci-Fi City, Ancient Egypt, Far Far Away, and The Lost World

attractions.name: Fort Canning Park
attractions.description: A tranquil green hill filled with colonial history, spice gardens, and city views

attractions.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
attractions.description: Peaceful gardens with shaded pathways, tropical landscapes, lakes, and beautifully maintained green spaces offering a refreshing contrast to Singapore's futuristic attractions
attractions.entry_fee: Free entry (National Orchid Garden has separate ticket charges)

attractions.name: Marina Bay Street Circuit
attractions.description: Take a stroll along the public roads which include sections like Raffles Boulevard and the roads around the Singapore Flyer and Fullerton Hotel

attractions.name: ArtScience Museum
attractions.description: Famous for its lotus-inspired architecture, combining technology, immersive digital exhibits, and creative installations into a uniquely modern museum experience.
attractions.entry_fee: Approx. ₹1500–3000 per person depending on exhibits

attractions.name: Gardens by the Bay
attractions.description: Futuristic landscape with Giant Supertrees, cooled conservatories including Flower Dome and Cloud Forest, and Jurassic World experience. Illuminated gardens create a different atmosphere after sunset
attractions.entry_fee: Outdoor gardens free; conservatories ticketed separately

attractions.name: Little India
attractions.description: Cultural area with shops

attractions.name: Arab Street & Haji Lane
attractions.description: The heart of Singapore's Islamic quarter, where you'll find Sultan Mosque – golden-domed and iconic, and Haji Lane – indie boutiques, graffiti walls, cool cafés

attractions.name: Chinatown
attractions.description: Cultural area for souvenir buying

attractions.name: Mandai Wildlife Reserve – Night Safari
attractions.description: A truly unique experience. Glide through dimly lit forests on a tram to spot nocturnal creatures in naturalistic habitats: from leopards and hyenas to glow-in-the-dark insects

attractions.name: Jewel Changi Airport
attractions.description: Stunning indoor landscape at Changi Airport featuring the Canopy Bridge, Canopy Park, lush greenery, and architectural design

attractions.name: Arab Street
attractions.description: Cultural area with shops

attractions.name: Singapore Zoo
attractions.description: Award-winning open-concept park with white tigers, giraffes, orangutans, and elevated boardwalks

attractions.name: Mandai Bird Paradise
attractions.description: Reimagined bird park featuring cascading aviaries and immersive environments

attractions.name: Night Safari
attractions.description: Unique experience gliding through dimly lit forests on a tram to spot nocturnal creatures in naturalistic habitats

attractions.name: Orchard Road
attractions.description: Singapore's most famous shopping and lifestyle boulevard lined with stylish malls, cafés, public art spaces, and tree-lined streets

attractions.name: Merlion Park
attractions.description: Singapore's iconic Merlion statue overlooking Marina Bay with some of the city's best skyline views from the waterfront promenade.

attractions.name: Sea Aquarium
attractions.description: Aquarium at Sentosa Island

attractions.name: Skyline Luge
attractions.description: Funicular adventure

attractions.name: Universal Studios
attractions.description: Theme park

attractions.name: Siloso Beach
attractions.description: Beach for relaxing evening

attractions.name: Tanjong Beach
attractions.description: Beach for relaxing evening

attractions.name: S.E.A. Aquarium
attractions.description: One of Asia's most impressive aquariums, home to massive underwater viewing panels, vibrant marine life, and beautifully designed exhibits.

attractions.name: Madame Tussauds Singapore
attractions.description: Wax figures of movie stars and sports icons with optional Marvel 4D experience

attractions.name: Wings of Time
attractions.description: Iconic evening show combining water projections, music, laser effects, and fireworks against the open sea at Sentosa Beach

attractions.name: National Orchid Garden
attractions.description: Singapore's most famous orchid collection with thousands of colorful blooms, located within Singapore Botanic Gardens

attractions.name: Singapore Flyer
attractions.description: Giant observation wheel offering panoramic views of the city

attractions.name: Singapore Changi Airport
attractions.description: One of the world's most efficient and beautifully designed airports — feels more like a lifestyle destination with indoor gardens, art installations, and shopping zones.

attractions.name: Marina Bay Sands
attractions.description: One of Singapore's most recognizable landmarks dominating the skyline with futuristic architecture and panoramic waterfront setting.

attractions.name: Spectra Light & Water Show
attractions.description: A beautifully choreographed waterfront light show featuring fountains, lasers, projections, and music against the Marina Bay skyline.

attractions.name: HydroDash Sentosa
attractions.description: A floating inflatable water park located directly on the beach.

attractions.name: Ola Beach Club
attractions.description: A relaxed beachfront venue ideal for sunset views, tropical drinks, kayaking, and slow beachside lounging.

attractions.name: Mastercard Canopy Bridge
attractions.description: Suspended glass bridge overlooking Jewel Changi's stunning indoor landscape with elevated views of lush greenery and architectural design below

attractions.name: Canopy Park
attractions.description: Combines artistic installations, gardens, and open spaces under natural light streaming through the glass structure at Jewel Changi

attractions.name: Flower Dome
attractions.description: Cooled conservatory at Gardens by the Bay with seasonal floral displays

attractions.name: Cloud Forest
attractions.description: Cooled conservatory at Gardens by the Bay with mist, dramatic greenery, and a spectacular indoor waterfall

attractions.name: Jurassic World: The Experience
attractions.description: Immersive Jurassic World themed experience at Gardens by the Bay

attractions.name: ION Orchard
attractions.description: Premium shopping space and lifestyle stores along Orchard Road, ideal for browsing, coffee stops, and photography

attractions.name: Ngee Ann City (Takashimaya)
attractions.description: One of Singapore's largest shopping complexes with fashion, gifts, and lifestyle stores

attractions.name: Emerald Hill Road
attractions.description: Charming heritage street lined with colorful Peranakan-style houses and quieter surroundings for photographs

attractions.name: Paragon Shopping Centre
attractions.description: Elegant shopping destination with international brands and lifestyle stores

attractions.name: Singapore Panoramic City Drive
attractions.description: Comfortable introduction to Singapore's iconic landmarks and neighborhoods, showcasing contrast between futuristic skyscrapers, colonial-era buildings, vibrant districts, and landscaped streets

attractions.name: Singapore River Cruise
attractions.description: Cruise along Singapore River watching the skyline shift from daylight into a glittering display of reflections across the water with gentle breezes and illuminated buildings

attractions.name: Mount Faber Cable Car Station
attractions.description: Cable car ride gliding over Singapore's harbor and coastline with views transitioning from city landscapes and sea views to lush greenery
attractions.recommended_duration: 20–30 mins including boarding and photo opportunities

attractions.name: Skyline Luge Singapore
attractions.description: Sky Ride lifts you above Sentosa offering views of beaches, greenery, and coastline; luge tracks provide fun downhill turns and scenic routes

attractions.name: Singapore Oceanarium
attractions.description: Underwater world with large viewing panels surrounded by vibrant marine life; dim lighting, soft blue reflections, and slow movement of sea creatures create a peaceful atmosphere

attractions.name: Dopamine Land Singapore
attractions.description: Immersive attraction with colorful spaces, mirrors, sensory installations, playful lighting, and interactive elements designed to create a joyful and energetic atmosphere

attractions.name: Swan Lake
attractions.description: One of the most scenic and relaxing areas within Singapore Botanic Gardens for photographs and short walks

attractions.name: Rainforest Trail
attractions.description: Quieter pathway within Singapore Botanic Gardens surrounded by dense tropical greenery creating a peaceful atmosphere

attractions.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck
attractions.description: High above Singapore, the city unfolds in every direction with panoramic views of glass towers, green spaces, the harbor, and the surrounding skyline

attractions.name: ArtScience Museum – Future World by teamLab
attractions.description: Technology and creativity blend through digital installations, interactive projections, and immersive rooms where flowers bloom digitally, lights react to movement, and every space feels playful and visually striking

attractions.name: Museum of Ice Cream Singapore
attractions.description: Playful world filled with pastel-colored rooms, interactive installations, and creative spaces designed around imagination and nostalgia; one of Singapore's most photogenic experiences

hotels.name: Hotel Boss
hotels.location: Hotel Boss stands in a vibrant crossroads of culture and convenience. It sits snugly between Kampong Glam (Arab Street) and Little India, offering immediate access to rich heritage sites, artsy cafes, and local boutiques

local_dishes.name: Char Kway Teow (Veg version)
local_dishes.description: Flat rice noodles wok-fried with soy sauce, veggies, and egg (optional)

local_dishes.name: Carrot Cake (Chai Tow Kway)

local_dishes.name: Popiah (Fresh Spring Roll)
local_dishes.description: Paper-thin wrap filled with stewed turnip, veggies, and peanuts

local_dishes.name: Masala Dosa
local_dishes.description: Crisp rice-lentil crepe filled with spiced potatoes, served with chutneys

local_dishes.name: Vegetarian Briyani
local_dishes.description: Aromatic rice dish with spices, vegetables, and raita

local_dishes.name: Gado-Gado
local_dishes.description: Indonesian-style salad with peanut sauce, tempeh, tofu, and veggies

local_dishes.name: Sayur Lodeh
local_dishes.description: Light coconut vegetable curry, a Malay classic

local_dishes.name: Kaya Toast with Kopi/Teh
local_dishes.description: Toast with coconut jam & butter (vegan versions available)

local_dishes.name: Ice Kachang
local_dishes.description: Shaved ice mountain with syrup, beans, corn, and jelly (ask for vegetarian toppings)

local_dishes.name: Chendol
local_dishes.description: Sweet, icy and coconutty dessert that is made with coconut milk, palm sugar and shaved ice. It also contain green, jelly noodles made with rice flour

local_dishes.name: Vegan Chicken Rice
local_dishes.description: Aromatic ginger-infused rice, 'chicken' made of soybean or wheat gluten and the highlight, a tangy garlicky chilli dip

local_dishes.name: Thunder Tea Rice
local_dishes.description: White rice, blanched or lightly stir-fried vegetables and peanuts are served with the star of the dish, a herb-infused tea soup

local_dishes.name: Prata
local_dishes.description: Roti prata is fried flatbread, and good ones are both crispy and fluffy. Ask for 'prata kosong' which means plain prata and let them know you do not eat egg

local_dishes.name: Stir fried Kai lan
local_dishes.description: It refers to Chinese broccoli, that is stir-fried and then tossed with a little oil to give it a smooth glossy sheen

local_dishes.name: Rojak
local_dishes.description: An eclectic medley of fruits and vegetables drenched in a sweet, sour and sometimes spicy, tamarind sauce

local_dishes.name: Char Kway Teow
local_dishes.description: Flat rice noodles stir-fried with egg, prawns, cockles, Chinese sausage, and soy sauce
local_dishes.where_to_try: Lao Fu Zi Fried Kway Teow

local_dishes.name: Laksa
local_dishes.description: Spicy coconut curry noodle soup, usually with prawns, cockles, and fishcake

local_dishes.name: Kueh
local_dishes.description: Colourful cakes and desserts that are soft, slightly chewy and sticky. They are made with common ingredients like rice, coconut, palm sugar and tapioca starch

local_dishes.name: Fried Spring roll
local_dishes.description: Crispy spring rolls that are deep fried and have a strong flavour of turnip, carrots and cabbage

local_dishes.name: Bandung
local_dishes.description: Chilled drink that is made with condensed milk and rose cordial syrup, giving it a pink colour

local_dishes.name: Popiah
local_dishes.description: Fresh spring rolls stuffed with veggies wrapped in thin rice sheets. It is best served with a sweet sauce (often a bean sauce) or hot chilli sauce

local_dishes.name: Tau Huay
local_dishes.description: Silken beancurd custard that is slightly more set than typical custard

local_dishes.name: Red bean buns
local_dishes.description: Red bean paste is a popular sweet and moreish filling for many bread-type of desserts. Pancakes, buns and waffles can be stuffed with this paste, which has a thick, reddish-black colour

local_dishes.name: Potato curry puff
local_dishes.description: The humble curry puff is a popular snack which is vegetarian-friendly

local_dishes.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
local_dishes.description: Poached chicken served with fragrant rice cooked in chicken stock, with chili sauce and ginger paste

local_dishes.name: Chili Crab
local_dishes.description: Fresh crab stir-fried in a tangy, sweet, and spicy tomato-chili sauce

local_dishes.name: Satay
local_dishes.description: Grilled skewers of marinated meat served with peanut sauce, ketupat (rice cakes), and cucumber-onion sides

local_dishes.name: Hokkien Mee
local_dishes.description: Stir-fried egg noodles and rice noodles with prawns, squid, and rich seafood stock

local_dishes.name: Roti Prata
local_dishes.description: Crispy yet fluffy Indian flatbread, often served with curry

local_dishes.name: Kaya Toast
local_dishes.description: Toasted bread with coconut jam (kaya) and butter, paired with soft-boiled eggs and soy sauce

local_dishes.name: Mee Goreng
local_dishes.description: Bold and flavorful stir-fried noodle dish influenced by Singapore's Indian-Muslim culinary culture; vegetarian version combines noodles, vegetables, spices, and rich sauces with a slightly sweet and savory flavor profile

local_dishes.name: South Indian Vegetarian Thali
local_dishes.description: Traditional vegetarian meals served with rice, breads, curries, vegetables, pickles, and accompaniments; authentic Indian vegetarian dining experience in Singapore's Little India area
local_dishes.where_to_try: Komala Vilas Restaurant, Annalakshmi Restaurant, Madras New Woodlands Restaurant

local_dishes.name: Vegan Burgers
local_dishes.description: Creative vegetarian comfort food and globally inspired plant-based flavors from Singapore's strong plant-based café culture

local_dishes.name: Coconut Ice Cream & Tropical Desserts
local_dishes.description: Refreshing desserts with coconut flavors, tropical fruits, and lighter options especially enjoyable after sightseeing in Singapore's warm tropical weather
local_dishes.where_to_try: Sentosa Island dessert kiosks, Marina Bay Sands dessert outlets, VivoCity dessert cafés

local_dishes.name: Bubble Tea & Specialty Tea Drinks
local_dishes.description: Huge variety of bubble teas, fruit teas, matcha beverages, and specialty drinks available across Singapore's café culture
local_dishes.where_to_try: Marina Bay area cafés, VivoCity beverage outlets, Sentosa Island cafés

local_dishes.name: Truffle & Mushroom Specialties
local_dishes.description: Modern vegetarian dining incorporating truffle flavors and gourmet mushroom dishes, particularly in contemporary restaurants
local_dishes.where_to_try: Joie Restaurant (Truffle risotto), Elemen (Truffle fried rice), LingZhi Vegetarian (Truffle noodles)

local_dishes.name: Kaya Jam
local_dishes.description: Rich coconut and pandan spread traditionally enjoyed with toast and tea; one of Singapore's most iconic flavors
local_dishes.where_to_try: VivoCity, Singapore Changi Airport, Major supermarkets around Bugis and Marina Bay areas
